analysis.title: US Conviction List - Directors' Cut: October 29, 2026 Update
key_insights: Goldman Sachs removes DoorDash (DASH) from the US Conviction List on October 29, 2026. DASH was on the list for 269 days.
Performance while on the list: total return of -13.4%, -25.2% relative to the S&P 500, and -25.5% relative to the S&P 500 Equal Weight (prices as of October 29, 2026, 2:15PM).

GS states removal can reflect lost analyst conviction (e.g. a downgrade), price realization, passage of catalysts, or the committee finding better opportunities elsewhere. The list targets 20-25 Buy-rated stocks across Americas coverage.
Per GS's rating definitions, adding or removing a stock from a Conviction List does not represent a change in the analysts' investment rating for that stock.

GS discloses it is acting as financial advisor on an announced strategic matter involving DoorDash or one of its affiliates, and has investment banking, market-making and other client relationships with it.

market_movers.rationale: DASH is removed from the US Conviction List after 269 days with a -13.4% total return. The latest target price in the history table is $280 (12-Oct-26, closing price $194.24). The report does not say the rating changed. The disclosures show a closing price of $169.49.

risk_factors: Conflict of interest: GS does and seeks to do business with covered companies, and expects to seek investment banking compensation from DoorDash in the next 3 months.
GS is acting as financial advisor on an announced strategic matter involving DoorDash or an affiliate.
